stages.name: ROOM_DETECTION
stages.description: Detects and classifies rooms from floor plan drawing using OpenCV contour analysis.

stages.name: AREA_MEASUREMENT
stages.description: Computes area of each detected room using geometric computation (Shapely).
stages.review_prompt: Please verify the detected room boundaries before area calculation proceeds.

stages.name: BOM_GENERATION
stages.description: Generates structured Bill of Materials JSON from verified room measurements.
